title: feat(app-shell): ADR-0090 D2 UI — provenance + default badges replace the profile toggle
body:
## What

Applies the objectui half of framework **ADR-0090 D2** (Profile removal) — the UI stops exposing a concept the platform no longer has, and surfaces the two flags that replaced it:

- **PermissionMatrixEditor**: the `isProfile` switch and Profile/Permission-set subtitle are gone; the header strip now shows a **provenance badge** (📦 Package vs ✏️ Custom, from `managedBy`/`packageId` — ADR-0086 D3) and a **"Default for new users" badge** (`isDefault`, the ADR-0090 D5 install-time suggestion).
- **Studio Access rail**: the `profile` marker on permission-set rows becomes a `default` marker.
- **Permission list** (`builtinComponents`): the Type column (Profile / Permission set) becomes a Source column (Package / Custom).
- **PermissionPreview**: the star icon now marks the suggested-default set, not "profile".
- **permission-slice**: draft type carries `isDefault`/`managedBy` instead of `isProfile`.
- **i18n**: profile keys removed, badge keys added, en-US + zh-CN in parity.

## What this deliberately does NOT touch

The alias normalization in `ObjectSettingsPanel` (from #2348) and the Position/岗位 relabels stay until objectui bumps to the @objectstack major that ships the framework P1 breaking wave (#2697) — removing them against a backend that still speaks the old vocabulary would break rendering. Tracked on framework#2696's objectui follow-up item.

## Verification

app-shell suite green: 77 test files / 610 tests (includes the permission-matrix scope tests and the i18n locale-parity gate).
